dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped rings show sharp high-contrast transitions from dark dorsal fur to light-colored pixel perimeters. Several prominent rings on the upper mid-dorsal region exhibit clear gradient transitions from darker exterior pixels to lighter, pale interior bands.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of irregular, non-gradient light pixel clusters is concentrated along the lower lateral flank and towards the posterior. These clusters appear as solid high-intensity fragments without defined internal architecture.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent 'O' shaped macro-annuli on the mid-dorsal surface form a nearly isosceles triangle, with the vertex pointing towards the seal's anterior-lateral right side.

other_distinctive_markers: Reticulated network where multiple annuli converge on the upper dorsal area, creating a interconnected mesh-like visual structure rather than isolated rings.
